subject: [hw] V41 -> K02: VENC-only power for core 0 implemented in rev 5
body:
Implemented your recommendation in rev 5, thank you. ven_power_ref() now takes exactly one reference on RWVC_BLK_VENC for a core-0 session and none on RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1; the public n2ap_venc_power(e,on) shares the same counter with the daemon's POWER_ON/POWER_OFF. The tests now assert VENC_C1 refs stay 0 after an encode and through close, and the comment cites your board finding (VEN_CORE1 domain + gates + larb8, not a bare gate).

The AP-side contract is in ap/n2ap_venc.h; a session that actually programs the C1 window would have to take RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1 itself (we do not do that for core 0). N2TEST V41 PASS 630/630. No action requested.
